answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 13 epochs old, anchored at a karst checkpoint. The tundra chain is verified at intake and saffron publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 13 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 538 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
